nodes.label: Pterodactyl Panel v1.12.2
nodes.rationale: Each addon stays in its own directory. Rewrite addons without modifying the panel itself — non-destructive upgrade approach.

nodes.label: Unix Theme v2.2.0
nodes.rationale: Replaces destructive RouteServiceProvider overrides with service-provider injection + Blade section stacking for v1.12.2 compatibility.

nodes.label: Billing System v1.x (v1.43)
nodes.rationale: Replaces deprecated PayPal SDK and laravel-invoices with modern equivalents (PayPal Checkout SDK, direct Stripe).

nodes.label: Custom Server Sort 1.0.3
nodes.rationale: Rewritten as DOM-injection JS with MutationObserver for non-destructive sortable integration, localStorage persistence per user.

nodes.label: Service Provider Injection Pattern
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive alternative to overriding core panel files; routes and views registered via ServiceProvider boot().

nodes.label: Blade @stack/@push Section Stacking Pattern
nodes.rationale: Replaces file overrides with @stack directives enabling theme components to inject into panel layout without modification.

nodes.label: DOM-Injection JavaScript Pattern
nodes.rationale: Custom Server Sort uses MutationObserver to watch DOM for server list render, then attaches SortableJS — avoids React component patching.
